categories.scope_limit: The examples concern different estimator, objective and asymptotic-scope changes. They support a recurring task relationship in the selected papers, not a shared technical mechanism or a mandatory novelty-sentence format.

source_checks.source_relationship: Multiple simultaneous transmit signals make a previous estimator treat other transmit signals as interference, motivating a new estimation task.
The source separately identifies nonconcavity, unit-modulus constraints, coupled variables and mismatched prior objectives before its solver direction.
The source distinguishes an infinite-tone duality basis from explicit evaluation at practical finite tone counts.

categories.source_supported_common_task_description: Fix the meaning or role of an object before its term, order or performance interpretation can be confused with another object.
categories.scope_limit: Terminology, encoding order and achievable-rate scope are different subtypes. Their grouping is an analyst abstraction; explicit role identification can occur through definitions, figures or precise references.

categories.scope_limit: The sources distinguish detection from estimation, theorem conditions from scheduling optimality, and sum-rate results from whole regions. The open-region status belongs to its publication context and is not independently verified as current.

source_checks.source_relationship: The source separates asymptotically vanishing detection error from remaining estimation error and Part II rate analysis.

source_checks.source_relationship: The model specifies cells, antennas, terminal counts, synchronization, TDD, reuse and flat-fading scope before the uplink expression.

categories.source_supported_common_task_description: Identify what a mathematical result resolves or leaves unresolved before a subsequent theorem, recovery step or original-objective conclusion.

reader.interpretation: These are recurrent reader-task relationships instantiated in selected published-paper passages. The source passages are actual examples; their grouping, reader-benefit hypotheses and proposed transfer criteria are analyst interpretations. They are neither features demonstrated in all excellent papers nor experimentally validated superiority.

critical_note_review.editorial_resolution: Raw counterexample analysis conflicts with the later editorial decision, which explicitly rejects the missing-benchmark-type reading and accepts a scoped result-to-boundary conclusion.
critical_note_review.recommendation: Remove or isolate the unresolved analyst criticism in context_notes, reader_after, final sentence role, full_relation_chain, actual_reader_benefit and minimum_edit. Do not demand deletion of maximum solely from this annotation. Retain source-observed distinctions among sufficient RF-chain conditions, heuristics, numerical findings and perfect-CSI applicability.
critical_note_review.evidence_boundary: Benchmark validity needs technical checking; the paragraph itself does state perfect CSI and its benchmark purpose.

critical_note_review.editorial_resolution: Raw counterexample and presumed rereading burden are superseded by a mixed, accept-with-boundary decision acknowledging explicit source qualifications.
critical_note_review.recommendation: Retain it as a source example of evidence-scope distinction. Relabel any confusion or rereading claim as an untested analyst concern; do not call an explicitly qualified expectation an established source defect.
critical_note_review.evidence_boundary: The high-SNR expectation is not a formal guarantee; the source marks that distinction.

critical_note_review.editorial_resolution: The source follows its ease-of-implementation assessment with a complexity comparator and software route. The phrase suggesting replacement of an unsupported slogan overstates the analyst inference.
critical_note_review.recommendation: Retain the actual performance-to-implementation, comparator-and-route example. Revise actual_reader_benefit to a hypothesized benefit without asserting the source was unsupported. Keep runtime, compatibility and online-update limits separate as technical boundaries.
critical_note_review.evidence_boundary: Textual complexity and software claims do not prove equal costs in every online mode or universal practical superiority.

distinctions.note: The source itself gives applicability counterexamples; these are constructive scope explanations, not analyst criticism of a writing defect.
The figure/metric mismatch is an analysis metadata error, not a demonstrated defect in the source paragraph.

reader.review_scope: All 34 unique highlighted source cases checked, using earlier per-case source/context audits for this slice and targeted inspection of the nine other highlighted cases. Also checked both raw counterexample labels and the requested implementation case. No exhaustive new review of all 189 passages or current literature search performed.

technical.basis: Previously completed comparison of original analysis with stored source-page contexts; no new mathematical reproof.

role_definitions.source_task_example: The source text actually describes a way of completing a technical explanation, construction, evaluation, or proof-organization task. This classification does not independently validate all of its mathematics.
role_definitions.source_scope_boundary_example: The source itself states relevant assumptions, evidence limits, tradeoffs, unproved parts, or unfinished tasks. The boundary is a source description, not an analyst-established defect.
role_definitions.analyst_critical_note: An analyst raises a question or criticism whose status must remain separate from source strengths and from a verified whole-paper defect.
role_definitions.mixed: The case contains usable source task or boundary material and a separately identified analyst critical note. Runtime example use must separate those components.

technical.interpretation: The library contains source-specific examples of recurring explanation tasks and explicit boundary-setting, plus analyst notes. It does not establish that these are advantages shared by every selected paper, universal rules, or reasons those papers are superior to different writing.
technical.case_recurrence_count_limit: Counts refer to existing navigation candidate assignments across the 52 technical papers. Categories overlap and the index is curated; counts must not be summed into independent evidence or treated as a population prevalence estimate.
technical.runtime_recommendation: Source examples may inform a target review only where the target claim calls for the same task. Mixed-case analyst critiques require separate labels and must not be loaded as positive source-author rules. Target sufficiency and chosen formats remain independent judgments.
